# Prodoto

> > Prodoto is a UK-based commercial photography and CGI studio specializing in product photography, room set imagery, and 3D rendering for ecommerce brands.

Located near Leeds and Manchester, Prodoto offers comprehensive visual content services including traditional product photography, CGI rendering, stop motion animation, and lifestyle shoots. They work with brands across fashion, furniture, workwear, and jewellery sectors, combining photography expertise with cutting-edge CGI technology.

## Key Topics

- Product Photography
- CGI & 3D Rendering
- Ecommerce Photography
- Room Set Photography
- Commercial Photography Studio
- Fashion Photography
- Lifestyle Photography

- AI in Photography

## Core Services

- [Product Photography Studio Services & Agency UK](https://www.prodoto.com/product-photography): Professional product photography studio for packshots & lifestyle images
- [Expert Product CGI Services Studio & Agency](https://www.prodoto.com/cgi): Professional CGI product photography & 3D rendering services near Leeds
- [Professional Furniture Photography Studio Services & Agency UK](https://www.prodoto.com/room-set-photography/furniture): Furniture photography studio creating inspiring room set images
- [PPE Safety Workwear Product Photography Studio Services & Agency UK](https://www.prodoto.com/product-photography/ppe-safety-workwear): PPE & workwear photography with mannequin, models & CGI near Manchester
- [Professional Jewellery Photography Studio & Agency UK](https://www.prodoto.com/product-photography/jewellery-photography): Professional jewellery photography studio near Manchester & Leeds
- [Professional Product Stop Motion Animation & Photography Studio Agency UK](https://www.prodoto.com/product-photography/stop-motion): Stop motion animation services for product photography near Manchester
- [Studio Services - Leading Commercial Photography Studio](https://www.prodoto.com/our-other-services): Yorkshire-based commercial photography studio services & facilities
- [Professional Prop Hire With Our Photo & Video Shoots](https://www.prodoto.com/props): Professional prop hire service for photo & video shoots
